ref.title: Rare but relevant: Ibogaine and cardiovascular complications—prolonged QT interval and ventricular arrhythmias

sources.title: Rare but relevant: Ibogaine and cardiovascular complications-prolonged QT interval and ventricular arrhythmias

design.quote: Evidence from observational, open‑label, and limited randomized placebo‑controlled trials indicates that ibogaine and its metabolite noribogaine reduce craving and withdrawal symptoms in opioid and cocaine‑dependent individuals, primarily through multiple pharmacological mechanisms; however, ibogaine presents a rare yet clinically significant cardiotoxic risk: QTc prolongation and potentially fatal ventricular arrhythmias such as Torsades des Pointes.

findings.quote: Future ibogaine‑assisted treatment should be conducted exclusively under controlled medical supervision, with CYP2D6 genotyping and rigorous monitoring of cardiovascular functioning.
findings.text: Risk can be reduced by conducting ibogaine treatment exclusively under controlled medical supervision, with CYP2D6 genotyping and rigorous monitoring of cardiovascular functioning.

findings.quote: Recent efforts to improve safety of ibogaine include different dosing strategies, cardiovascular monitoring and the development of ibogaine analogues, which retain anti‑addictive efficacy while lacking cardiotoxicity in preclinical models.
findings.text: Risk can be reduced by using different dosing strategies, cardiovascular monitoring, and developing ibogaine analogues that lack cardiotoxicity in preclinical models.
